Find out about the University of Manitoba Graduate Fellowships (UMGF) for the Department of Statistics. Feel free to contact us if you have any questions.
Graduate students
University of Manitoba Graduate Fellowships (UMGF)
University graduate fellowships are offered to full-time master’s and PhD students to recognize and support academic excellence. The fellowships are offered to students who have demonstrated superior intellectual ability and academic accomplishment.
Eligibility
Students must have a minimum GPA of 3.75 to be considered for this award. A student may apply for this award multiple times, and a student who wins this award as an M.Sc. student is still eligible to win it during their PhD program.
Process
Students must apply for this award. Applications include:
an up-to-date curriculum vitae (including awards/honours, and more),
a research statement/outline of proposed research ( maximum 2 pages), and
if applicable, please provide a description of any obstacles you have encountered in your academic/research trajectory that may be relevant to your application.
Applications and three reference letters should be sent to Margaret Smith at Margaret.Smith@umanitoba.ca by May 1. Applications received after the deadline or incomplete applications will not be considered. Reference letters should include the research potential or a brief summary of the research as well as a discussion of its significance and potential impact.
Selection criteria
The Graduate Committee will choose the recipients. When evaluating the applications, the following weights will be given to:

EDI considerations will be taken into account for the review of the application process.
Department of Statistics graduate student conference support
Graduate students at the Department of Statistics can apply for travel support to attend conferences. To be eligible, the student must:
be a registered graduate student in the statistics department,
be a co-author on the accepted paper or poster and
be the person presenting the work.
Please download and fill out the forms below and send them to Margaret.Smith@umanitoba.ca.
